title: One high-nuclearity Eu18 nanoring with rapid ratiometric fluorescence response to dipicolinic acid (an anthrax biomarker)

synthesis.procedure: Under Schlenk conditions, at room temperature Eu(OAc)3·6H2O (0.20 mmol, 0.070 g), H4L1 (0.20 mmol, 0.0756 g) and H2L2 (2,3-dihydroxybenzaldehyde; 0.10 mmol, 0.0136 g) were dissolved in 9 mL EtOH, then triethylamine in MeOH (1.0 mol/L, 1 mL) was added. The mixture was heated under reflux with stirring for 30 min and cooled to room temperature. The clear solution was filtered and slow diffusion of diethyl ether for one week gave red crystals of 1. Elemental analysis was fitted to [Eu18(L1)8(HL2)2(OAc)20(MeOH)8(EtOH)6(H2O)4]·4(MeOH)(H2O) (C254H318N16O115Eu18).
synthesis.temperature: room temperature, then reflux, then cooled to room temperature
synthesis.time: 30 min reflux; crystallization for one week
synthesis.vessel_or_method: Schlenk technique; reflux then slow ether diffusion
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: Filtered clear solution; slow diffusion of diethyl ether for one week afforded red crystals.

properties.summary: In CH3CN, 1 shows ligand-centred emission at 490 nm and no detectable Eu(III) emission until DPA is added, which turns on the Eu 5D0→7Fj bands and quenches the ligand band, giving a ratiometric pale-green-to-orange response used to sense the anthrax biomarker DPA. Response time is about five seconds; Ksv is −0.43×10^4 M−1 and LOD is 14.2 μM.
